name: Poker EOS
rootCause: EOS game Poker EOS appears abnormal, which is confirmed to be caused by the disclosure of the private key of the game. The hackers made more than 20,000 EOS in total, and more than 10,000 of them have been transferred to the exchanges.

descriptions.text: EOS game Poker EOS appears abnormal, which is confirmed to be caused by the disclosure of the private key of the game. The hackers made more than 20,000 EOS in total, and more than 10,000 of them have been transferred to the exchanges.

Poker EOS lost over 26,900 EOS due to private key compromise on May 24, 2019. The attacker accessed multiple project accounts and withdrew funds to exchanges. The loss resulted from improper private key management, with no evidence of recovery. The attacker obtained the project account's private key, enabling unauthorized withdrawals from Poker EOS accounts. The access was attributed to improper key management by the Poker EOS team.
